description: datastash: inbox count at session start; a background inbox listener that wakes the session when messages arrive; the person's typed "datastash main" makes that session the person's main session; the person's typed status phrases ("status", "status of all my agents", "full context of N") are answered by the plugin itself from this computer's copy when keeping is on (no model turn, no network); any tool call that could carry datastash content (a datastash connector by name or URL, the datastash command or its files, a fetch from getdatastash.com, or anything it can't tell) records the session as an agent, which can never become main; at the end of a turn that used tools, an agent whose work changed (commits, changed files, a test run, a new ask) and whose status line was not updated is asked once to write it: at most every 10 minutes, only for a project that is kept, never while datastash has no status door, never looping; after a Bash call, a repeated lookup to an outside tool (gh PRs and CI, Linear, Jira, Sentry) is counted by its command shape only, and once datastash keeps that answer the agent gets one line saying where it is; the background listener also keeps a project map of each linked git folder, in plain code, mapped again only after a commit, for `datastash where` and `datastash file`; clean sessions (the person's own choices for all their agents): the session start gives the rules only for what is on, a Bash call by the main session (no agent_id in the hook input) gets one nudge line at most every 5 minutes, never a block and never reading the command, and the person's typed "no code in sessions", "turn off clean sessions" or "turn on clean sessions" is saved by the plugin.
